title: monardella villosa var. subserrata
intro: Monardella villosa var. subserrata, commonly known as Pine Mountain monardella, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing and immune system support. The therapeutic actions of Pine Mountain monardella include its ability to calm digestive issues, reduce stress, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
